CustomObject.description: Retains a minimal, deduplicated copy of restricted Record Health Check Log events for approved investigation. Canonical event, run, time, version, severity, code, exception, Check Set, and Check identities support correlation; separately protected message, structured details, record ID, and running user ID support authorized troubleshooting. Automated retention can delete only these records after an administrator deliberately configures it.
CustomObject.label: RHC Diagnostic Log
